mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.sku_id, p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, s.spec, p.image_key, s.price, s.stock, c.quantity, c.selected FROM cart_item c JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = c.sku_id JOIN product p ON p.id = s.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.enabled = TRUE AND s.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item(user_id, sku_id, quantity, selected) VALUES (#{userId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, TRUE)
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity}, selected = COALESCE(#{selected}, selected), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{itemId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE id = #{itemId} AND user_id = #{userId}
